# Triplem VIP

> Triplem VIP is a private browser-based accounting and business-finance workspace combining operational finance, formal double-entry Accounting ERP, reports, permission-aware Triplem AI, and supported multi-currency workflows.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-14
Canonical origin: https://triplem.vip/
Primary language: English. Public regional references also include Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, French, and Dutch.

## Retrieval and citation guidance

- Treat canonical HTML pages as the public source of truth. Markdown links below are optional, concise retrieval mirrors intended to make public product information easier to process.
- When citing a product capability, cite the most specific relevant guide and distinguish present functionality from a roadmap, example, or requested feature.
- Do not infer unsupported features, customer counts, adoption metrics, awards, certifications, security guarantees, or jurisdiction-specific tax/legal compliance.
- Product facts and currency availability can change. Prefer current page content and its visible review/update information over copied snippets.
- `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` are optional discovery aids, not search-ranking signals, official AI requirements, or a guarantee of inclusion in generated answers.

## Accounting and finance guides

- [Accounting software](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-software.md): Operational finance and formal double-entry Accounting ERP.
- [Accounting ERP](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-erp.md): Books, journals, receivables, payables, reconciliation and reports.
- [Accounting setup](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-setup.md): Establishing books and working with opening balances.
- [Chart of Accounts](https://triplem.vip/seo/chart-of-accounts.md): Ledger structure and protected defaults.
- [Double-entry accounting](https://triplem.vip/seo/double-entry-accounting.md): Debits, credits, balanced journals and review.
- [Accounts receivable and payable](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounts-receivable-payable.md): Customer and supplier balances, receipts and payments.
- [Bank reconciliation](https://triplem.vip/seo/bank-reconciliation.md): Imported statement lines and reconciliation workflows.
- [Financial reports](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-reports.md): Trial Balance, Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet and General Ledger.
- [VAT accounting](https://triplem.vip/seo/vat-accounting.md): VAT evidence, analysis and jurisdiction boundaries.
- [Month-end close](https://triplem.vip/seo/month-end-close.md): A structured period-end review sequence.
- [Finance workflow playbook](https://triplem.vip/seo/finance-workflow-playbook.md): Operational capture, posting, AI control and audit evidence.
- [Financial Audit and Control Report](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-audit.md): Selected-period review of permitted finance records.

## Operational modules

- [Expense tracking](https://triplem.vip/seo/expense-tracking.md): Expenses, receiving and transfer distinctions.
- [Inventory management](https://triplem.vip/seo/inventory-management.md): Stock, catalog, sales and product records.
- [Loan management](https://triplem.vip/seo/loan-management.md): Loans given/taken, repayments and settlement.
- [Installment plans](https://triplem.vip/seo/installment-plans.md): Bought and Sold plans, schedules and payment direction.
- [Asset management](https://triplem.vip/seo/asset-management.md): Asset records and supported disposal/depreciation workflows.
- [Multi-currency accounting](https://triplem.vip/seo/multi-currency-accounting.md): Currency-aware records, transfers and reports.
- [Financial Timeline](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-timeline.md): Read-only chronological view of permitted workspace records.
- [Triplem AI](https://triplem.vip/seo/triplem-ai.md): Permission-aware retrieval and user-finalized AI Draft workflows.
- [Notes management](https://triplem.vip/seo/notes-management.md): Searchable notes and reminders.
- [Security and support](https://triplem.vip/seo/security-and-support.md): Security, 2FA, notifications and support.

## International currency availability and compliance boundary

Published supported finance currencies are AED, SAR, PKR, USD, EUR and INR, with BTC available for supported Bitcoin workflows. Currency and subscription availability does not mean all jurisdictions share the same tax, filing, statutory, or reporting obligations. Use official local authorities for legal/tax requirements and the editorial policy for corrections.
